info.name: PayFlow V1
info.description: Production-quality Postman collection generated from the PayFlow V1 Spring Boot controllers, DTOs, security configuration, and API contract. Base URL is configurable through the PayFlow Local environment.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Public authentication endpoints. Login responses store tokens from data.accessToken and data.refreshToken.
